entities.name: Kostanay Maral Mosque

entities.summary: Maral Ishan Mosque, traditionally also known as the White Mosque, is the central and oldest mosque in the city of Kostanay, Kazakhstan. It is recognized as a monument of history and architecture of the Kostanay Region.
